target_customer: Automotive aftermarket installers and vehicle owners; Canadian Armed Forces
problem: Windshield replacement cost rose with ADAS; nano-coatings protect windshields and provide infrared camouflage.
business_model: Product sales (ExoShield films via installers and DIY kits) plus defense R&D contracts

technical_complexity.rationale: Nanomaterials R&D and field-trialed camouflage; from description only.

defensibility.rationale: Claimed proprietary nanotechnology and defense contracts; not verified.

market_need_then: Not researched: no contemporaneous source on demand at the time of founding was reached, so no evidence of need is asserted here.

brand_strength.rationale: Site tagline 'Protecting what matters' and product brand ExoShield; no external brand sources read.

outcome_analysis: Alchemy (YC S14) is Active, 25 people, with ExoShield films sold through 400+ installers in 56 countries and two Canadian Armed Forces contracts, all company claims. Funding and history were not found, so the drivers of its long survival are not established.
notes: Directory Active. Location listed as Waterloo, site says Kitchener. Customer counts are company claims.
